subject: FY26 CPA Funding Allocations
overview: The Community Preservation Committee met to deliberate and recommend funding for FY26 Community Preservation Act grant applications. The committee voted to recommend funding for seven projects while deferring decisions on four remaining proposals to January 2026.

items.title: FY26 CPA Funding Deliberations and Scenario Modeling
items.summary: The committee reviewed FY26 funding requests totaling $3.38 million against approximately $2.66 million in available CPA funds and established initial project priorities.

items.title: Riverside Plaza Shade Improvements
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $40,000 for expanded shade improvements at Riverside Plaza, conditioned on public engagement and avoiding a net reduction in tree canopy.

items.title: Affordable Housing Trust FY26 Tranche
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $550,000 to the Medford Affordable Housing Trust for FY26 affordable housing initiatives.

items.title: Housing Families Homelessness Prevention Program
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $75,000 for Housing Families' homelessness prevention program, requiring quarterly reporting on program administration.

items.title: Playstead Park Digital Scoreboard
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $100,000 for a digital scoreboard at Playstead Park, conditioned on exploring solar options and ensuring the equipment can be relocated in the future.

items.title: Brooks Estate ADA Pathways and Parking Construction
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $602,000 to the Medford Brooks Estate Land Trust for ADA pathway and parking lot construction.

items.title: Berry Park Community Garden
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $57,500 for the Berry Park Community Garden, conditioned on incorporating rodent prevention tactics in consultation with city staff.

items.title: Oak Grove Cemetery Access Road ADA Study
items.summary: The committee voted to recommend $35,000 for an ADA access road design study at Oak Grove Cemetery, conditioned on protecting mature trees.

items.title: Meeting Minutes and Next Steps
items.summary: The committee deferred approval of the November and December meeting minutes to the January 13 meeting.
